why_trail.why: Handoff is complete and verified. The run's governing constraint is that episodes are a RECORD, not a playbook: invariants 1, 2 and 4 are where that gets written into docs/agents/. Baseline guard state at 77e428d: 85 findings, single leg retired-name-on-shipped-surface, 23 paths; 33 of them are the design record that must SURVIVE untouched, so the leg can only reach zero via invariant 11's new approval census. Slice order is deliberate: prose first (m1-m4) so the residual set is final before the census (m5) is written against it.

docs/agents/ no longer tells an agent to read the store. CREW_CONTEXT's record-stores table lost its playbook row and its 'Read them with query_episodes.py' sentence; the episodes/ row is write-path-only. GLOSSARY's harvest now points INTO the store and episode drops 'kept for later harvest'. The ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT tombstone carries all five clauses. Measured consequence: the unapproved-store-mention leg is at ZERO (85 findings, all retired-name), and the only docs/agents residual is the tombstone naming the two files in order to forbid them -- approvable at m5, not a defect.

The store's why-a-tracked-path argument now rests on a true premise. The old one cited '.agent-work/ is gitignored (see .gitignore line 1)': measured false -- .gitignore line 1 is a comment saying .agent-work/ is TRACKED, and git ls-files .agent-work returns 3067. The argument survives, re-founded on what a plain tracked repo-root path actually buys (visible in every worktree and clone the moment a commit lands, nothing computed at runtime). The 'Not to be confused with' section is gone: it asserted the store was a SIBLING of the playbook and that this run does not touch it -- the exact claim #447 reverses. Also removed the now-false 'no automated capture wiring (#305)' claim, which g2 built, and the read-with-query_episodes instruction.

Every live pointer is repointed or removed. The lessons-auditor skill was deleted at g4, so its README/SKILL_INDEX/POSITIONING roster entries were removed rather than repointed. The AGENT_FEEDBACK/LESSONS pointers on README, CONSTELLATION_OVERVIEW, workbench, charter's AGENT_GUIDE template, commander-core, commander-delegated, admiral SKILL and fleet-doctrine were repointed at the store's WRITE path plus the record-not-a-rule clause. Measured consequence: the sweep introduced 12 NEW store mentions, each given its own reason in the store-mention census -- and the g1 census note's claim that zero entries sit under skills/ is now false, so the new block says so and restates the narrower property that actually matters (nothing tells an agent to READ the store). Two adjacent dangling referents fixed in files already in scope: admiral's four 'lessons audit' closeout references, and workbench SKILL.md's pointer to the deleted AGENT_FEEDBACK.template.md. Invariant 6 was held to ONE field: the CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK Lesson: field now takes an episode id but KEEPS ITS NAME, because collect_feedback.py fingerprints on the literal field name 'Lesson' and renaming it would silently drop the export's stable identity.

The design record stays a record. docs/RECURSIVE_IMPROVEMENT_DESIGN.md gained 16 inserted lines and ZERO deletions, and its LESSONS.md line count is 12 both at HEAD and now -- the header deliberately spells NO retired name, because spelling one would have moved that count and broken invariant 7's own check. docs/EPISODE_STORE.md's nine comparative references now describe the property (a validated all-or-nothing delta writer; a single running playbook read top-to-bottom by a human) instead of pointing at a module the reader cannot open. docs/superpowers/ and tests/fixtures/ show an empty diff. The header added one new store mention, approved with its own reason.

The leg can now reach green without being weakened. One parser serves both censuses: parse_approved/load_approved took an optional census_path, and no second implementation was written -- test_the_two_censuses_share_one_parser asserts a malformed entry is refused identically and names the right file. 53 residuals approved, each with its own reason describing that line; none says an agent is still told to use the retired thing. The PATH half of the leg is deliberately left unapprovable and that choice is stated at the code site, because 'the census did not cover it' and 'the census must never cover it' read the same in code and mean opposite things. verify_retirement.py now exits 0 printing nothing.
